description: This file implements a chat handler class for a web application, managing chat messages, user sessions, and real-time updates via AJAX. It includes database connection setup, user management, message parsing, and chat data retrieval.

classes.name: Chat
classes.description: A class managing chat functionalities such as message retrieval, user management, and message submission.

methods.name: Chat
methods.description: Constructor initializing chat session and handling AJAX submode requests.

methods.name: getAJAX
methods.description: Returns the current JSON data representing chat state.

methods.name: setUserNick
methods.description: Initializes or updates the user's nickname and session in the database.

methods.name: getUserList
methods.description: Generates a list of active users in the chat.

methods.name: lastMsgId
methods.description: Updates the last received message ID from POST data.

methods.name: getAllPVChat
methods.description: Retrieves private chat messages newer than the last message ID.

methods.name: msgParse
methods.description: Parses special commands within chat messages (e.g., change nick, help, date/time).

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Processes and stores a submitted chat message.

methods.name: pvClose
methods.description: Closes a private chat session by deleting related messages.
